title: Profile cosmetics overlays, profile badge display, global theme backgrounds, and streak freeze price UI update

requirements.summary: Update all frontend streak freeze cost displays and checks to use 50 coins consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to purchase a streak freeze with < 50 coins fails with an error message mentioning 50 coins.
Attempting to purchase a streak freeze with >= 50 coins succeeds (assuming other backend validations pass).
The Timer section UI shows the cost as 50 coins (including the call-to-action button label and any helper text).
The backend constant/value used for streak freeze cost is 50 (no remaining hard-coded 100s for this feature).

file_operations.description: Create a shared frontend pricing constants module (e.g., export STREAK_FREEZE_COST = 50) so the cost is not duplicated across UI.

Replace the local STREAK_FREEZE_COST=100 with the shared constant from frontend/src/utils/prices.ts and ensure all displayed helper text/button labels and insufficient-coins messaging reflect 50 coins.

requirements.summary: Render the selected/owned avatar frame as a true overlay ring on top of the circular avatar edge (for both image and fallback initials).
acceptanceCriteria: When a user has a profile image, the frame is rendered as an overlay on top of the avatar and visibly frames the circular edge.
When a user has no profile image (fallback initials), the frame still overlays the circular avatar container.
If no frame is owned/selected, the avatar renders exactly as it did before (no empty overlay artifacts).

file_operations.description: Create a composed ProfileAvatar component that wraps the existing shadcn-ui Avatar and conditionally adds an absolutely-positioned overlay ring for the selected frame. Use a frameId->style mapping (e.g., gold/diamond/rainbow) and ensure the overlay sits above the avatar image/fallback. Use the shadcn-ui (selected component: shadcn-ui) Avatar capability; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the new ProfileAvatar component in place of the direct Avatar usage, wiring in the user's selected frame (from persisted cosmetics selection) and preserving existing upload/remove behaviors. This file also uses blob-storage ExternalBlob direct URL display capability (selected component: blob-storage); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Show a dedicated badges area on the Profile that includes streak milestone badges and coin-purchased badges, persisting the badge list for the user across reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: The Profile section shows a dedicated badges area/list/grid.
Streak milestone badge(s) (based on existing streak badge tier/state) appear in the Profile badges area when earned.
Coin-purchased badge(s) appear in the Profile badges area after purchase.
Badges shown on the profile persist across reloads/logins for the same user.

file_operations.description: Create a small cosmetics persistence hook that stores coin-purchased cosmetics (at minimum: purchasedBadgeIds and selectedFrameId/selectedThemeId if needed) in localStorage keyed by the logged-in principal (via existing Internet Identity context), so badges persist across reloads/logins on the same device.

Replace the current simulated-purchase-only flow with persistence via useCosmeticsInventory for badge items (and keep existing UI structure). Ensure purchasing a profile badge marks it as owned and prevents re-purchase, and that the owned state survives reloads.

Add a dedicated badges grid/area to the Profile UI. Populate it with (1) earned streak milestone badges based on existing streak milestone reward state and/or streak badge tier state, and (2) coin-purchased badges from useCosmeticsInventory. Ensure empty state is handled when no badges are owned/earned.

requirements.summary: Apply the currently selected purchased theme as a global app background and persist the selection for the user across reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: After selecting a purchased theme, the app background changes (not just inside the Background Settings UI).
The selected background persists across reloads/logins for the same user.
If the user has no selected theme/background, the app uses the default background styling (no broken/missing background).

file_operations.description: Create a small hook/context that provides the current global background value and a setter, persisted in localStorage keyed by logged-in principal. Support at least: default (empty), gradient string, and simple color backgrounds.

Wire the global background provider into the app shell and apply the selected background to the top-level app container so it affects all tabs. Ensure fallback to the default styling when no background is selected.

Connect the Themes tab actions to useAppBackground/useCosmeticsInventory so that selecting a purchased theme updates the global background immediately and persists. Use shadcn-ui components already present for consistent UI (selected component: shadcn-ui); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Integrate BackgroundSettings with the global background hook so that background changes from this UI apply globally (not only within the settings component) and persist. This file uses the camera hook capability (selected component: camera); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure default background styling remains intact and add minimal global styling support (e.g., a CSS variable target or safe defaults) so applying a global background does not break light/dark themes.
